Welcome to SuperCode, an industrial-grade Offline IDE and advanced Code Editor. We break mobile sandbox limits to provide software engineers, data scientists, and students with an uncompromising offline coding experience on Android.

Whether you require a robust Python IDE for data science, a high-performance C++ Compiler for systems programming, or a zero-configuration Java IDE, SuperCode brings desktop-grade programming directly to your device. It stands as a versatile python coding app and a rigorous C++ ide combined into one unified platform.

■ Comprehensive Multi-Language Sandbox & Native Runtime
Run a fully virtualized ecosystem without network dependencies. This is a true offline code editor engineered for your most complex workflows:

• Professional Python IDE & Compiler: Features an industrial-grade, isolated Python 3.11 runtime and a visual Pip manager. Supports offline installation of.whl local files (telebot, requests, flask). Our Smart AST scanner seamlessly intercepts and routes heavy data science libraries like NumPy and Pandas to our Serverless Edge WASM cluster for uncompromising execution, ensuring the local sandbox remains ultra-lightweight.

• Hardcore C/C++ Compiler: Driven by the LLVM/Clang core, it compiles and executes C11/C++20 locally and entirely offline. As a highly reliable C++ IDE, it includes a built-in 150,000-character buffer lock to safely intercept infinite loops and prevent OOM errors.

• Native Java IDE: Incorporates local ECJ compilers and D8 engines for genuine offline compilation. Instantly compile and desugar Java code into Dex native formats, loaded dynamically via DexClassLoader. Fully supports modern Java 8+ syntax within an independent thread sandbox.

• Web Editor & WASM Sandbox: Utilizing a Virtual HTTP Sandbox, it executes HTML, CSS, JS, and WebAssembly. It operates as a highly capable Web Editor and precise HTML editor with local absolute path mapping. It provides the ideal environment to run JavaScript offline and test web designs instantly.

• Lua & Shell Scripting: Execute Lua scripts seamlessly within a secure local sandbox. Connect directly to the underlying Linux kernel with a native Shell Terminal (Bash/Sh) for on-the-go automation script debugging.

• Cloud Language Routing: Writing Kotlin (KT), PHP, or SQL? Our built-in smart routing detection system seamlessly connects to high-performance cloud clusters. This extends your IDE & Code Editor capabilities across multivariant cloud topologies, ensuring frictionless code execution for server-side environments.

■ WebAssembly Driven: Smart Code Editor
Breaking performance bottlenecks, SuperCode utilizes WebAssembly-driven Tree-Sitter AST (Abstract Syntax Tree) parsers to deliver a superior IDE & Code Editor experience:
• Context-aware symbol navigation and sub-millisecond intelligent completion down to the leaf node.
• AST syntax highlighting runs parallel with TextMate lexical aesthetics to eliminate coloring conflicts, ensuring unparalleled visual accuracy.
• Supports TextMate JSON & VS Code themes (Darcula/Monokai). 
• Power Mode: Immersive typewriter particle effects.

■ Memory Guard & 150K-Line Engine
• Anti-OOM: Secures 30MB footprint via active cache evacuation, completely eliminating LMK/ANR crashes.
• O(1) Viewport: Skips off-screen rendering to instantly open 150K-line logs & PDFs with 120Hz scrolling.

■ Enterprise DevOps & File Topology
• Visual Git Integration: Perform complete Clone, Commit, Push, and Pull operations with a topological submission tree to intuitively resolve merge conflicts.

• Remote Server Sync: Direct production deployment and real-time environment synchronization via secure SFTP/FTP.

Redefine mobile development. Download SuperCode today to experience a profoundly capable Offline IDE and Code Editor directly in the palm of your hand.
